content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the possibility of a spurious wakeup allowing a thread to incorrectly succeed in acquiring a mutex that it already owned. This occurred when a second call to `mutex_lock()` on the same mutex would block, but then the thread would receive a spurious wakeup, leading it to believe it could claim ownership again due to the mutex's owner pointer still pointing to itself. The patch introduced a new flag to manage the handoff process more effectively and prevent this incorrect behavior.
